title: release sprt
summary: A release monitor observes independent requests and must distinguish an acceptable error rate p0=0.01 from an unacceptable rate p1=0.03. The predeclared type-I and type-II error limits are alpha=0.05 and beta=0.10. So far 200 requests include 5 errors. The team must decide now whether the evidence accepts p0, accepts p1, or requires continued sampling under the predeclared sequential design.
